description: Dept. of Elections - Elected Mr. Aryawansha Padma Sri Munasinghe as Vice Chairman of the Panadura Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in the office of Vice Chairman of the Panadura Urban Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the declaration of an elected official to fill a vacancy created by a previous officeholder's appointment to another position. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate declarations, and election-related appointments.
